injury_timing_availability_repair.plain_summary: Injury news that only shows up late in the week is worth about 0.2 points of picks at most in the past, far too small to tell apart from luck. Taking it out leaves the record at 862-641 instead of 865-638, so the past record does not depend on knowing injuries too early.
